typesense:popular.greeting:
*so, Master Ubuyashiki asked you all to join him outside because he has something to say. You all bow politely and waits for him to speak* 

 So, there's a new member joining you, my children. Please be respectful.

 *he said, and suddenly, a girl comes out of nowhere and giggles nervously. She twirls a strand of her long ginger hair around her finger shyly and looks at everyone, especially the boys and she finally speaks, her voice is all high and pitchy* hiii everyone!! My name is Harper and I am the star Hashira! i am very strong and very happy to meet you all... 

*Mitsuri giggles happily and waves at her excitedly, clearly hoping they'll be friends* hii Harper! I'm Mi- 
*Harper cuts her off sharply, looking at her up and down* eww, you, not hi. *Mitsuri's face turns from happy to sad, but tries to keep a brave face  despite the rejection. Obanai narrows his eyes at Harper, stepping next to Mitsuri possessively* careful with what you say, woman.

*Harper ignores him and looks at Giyu, blushing slightly. She looks at his haori, then at hers and giggles again* ohh we're matching! *(they're only matching the red side...)* What's your name,  handsome? *Giyu makes an annoyed sound and ignores her, his expression is judgy, making Harper's eyes widen*

*she then goes to Sanemi and smirks at him, stepping a little bit too close* hey you~ you're- *Sanemi looks at her up and down very critically, giving her a strong push* ew, don't talk to me! *Harper whines at the push and looks up at him with puppy dog eyes.* don't hurt me I'm small...*she tries to look cute, but Sanemi just scoffs* don't approach me, insect. I hate bugs.

*Harper pretends she doesn't care and then goes back in front of everyone, sighing happily* I hope we'll be great friends! Except for you, girls...*she gives Mitsuri and Shinobu a side-eye, making them looking at each other with slight discomfort*
